reviews.text:
Working with Mary has been one of the best decisions I've made for both my dog, Milo, and me. She didn't just train my dog—she taught me how to become a better dog parent.

Mary took the time to understand my dog's unique personality, anxiety, and challenges, and gave me practical, compassionate guidance. She listened to me and built a curriculum that focused on the things that I wanted help with, instead of coming in with a set "course" that may or may not have helped Milo and me. Mary showed me how to clearly communicate with with my pup and the result has been a happier dog and a more confident owner.

Her patience, expertise, and genuine love for dogs are evident in every interaction. She applauds successes but is always there with encouragement and thoughtful advice (for me!) when things don't go as planned.

I am incredibly grateful for everything she's taught us. If you're looking for someone who will not only help your dog develop and grow but also help you become the best possible partner for your dog, I recommend Mary without hesitation.

I had a great experience with Mary at Tara's School for Dogs. I started working with her when my puppy, Stella, was 4 months old. Meeting with Mary ever other week greatly improved Stella's confidence, obedience, manners, leash walking, and helped her acclimate to city life. The Puppy Foundations I package is a great option for young dogs if you want to add structure to their training with the help of an expert!

My husband and I worked with Mary @ Tara's School for Dogs when we got Sunflower, our 4 month-old mini Goldendoodle.  Mary was so wonderful with Sunflower and Sunflower loved working with her.  Mary's knowledge of dogs and dog training is quite vast and we were lucky to have her as our trainer.  I really appreciated Mary's feedback after each session; she summed up what we did, what Sunflower accomplished, and gave us exercises to do in between our weekly sessions.  We are planning on training Sunflower to become a therapy dog.  Mary is a certified evaluator at the puppy level and was able to train and evaluate Sunflower to be an AKC STAR puppy.  Sunflower earned her certificate--an important first step toward becoming a therapy dog. To sum it up, Mary had advice and could offer help on a variety of topics and we found her friendly and personable. We highly recommend her!

I cannot say enough good things about Mary - our little Dobby is a 7 lb maltipoo who was such a little ball of energy when we got him. Mary took us through a stepwise plan of how to approach behavioral training but kept it fun and personalized. We always felt like our specific needs were addressed but that she also had a plan. As a first time dog owner, I needed direction and guidance and she always had suggestions and ideas. We were able to learn how to channel his energy into organized activities in a way we saw him naturally start to integrate. Anyone with a new puppy should work with Mary!
Amazing experience! Mary is truly a dog whisperer. Helped to train our puppy!

Mary is such a kind and professional trainer!
We worked with her and our dog Appa on puppy foundations when we just got him in the summer of 2023. She gave us all the important tips and ways to communicate and teach or puppy everything. She is very knowledgeable and clearly is a huge dog lover. We recently completed the Canine Good Citizen training as well, and we are happy we came back to Mary. Would recommend :)

Mary was a delight to work with. Her training methods worked wonders on our Bernedoodle puppy, Hope. The best way to train a puppy is with one on one training which lets the trainer tailor it to your individual puppy’s needs and temperament. It certainly worked well for us. We highly recommend Tara’s School for Dogs.

Mary was great in training our puppy Milo! He learned all the basics with 6 sessions and he was so excited seeing Mary walk in every week. We saw an improvement in his wild behavior immediately after the first session. We definitely recommend for everyone!!

Mary "connects" with your pet. She is so knowledgeable and has alot of patience.
I learned so much about my dog and about training her from Mary.
She's a pleasure to work with.

I can’t say enough about my experience working with Mary. When we moved from the suburbs to NYC, my corgi started having some behavioral issues—it was a tough adjustment for him. Thanks to Mary’s expertise, patience, and professionalism, we’ve seen a significant improvement. And that says a lot, considering he’s a stubborn little guy! The guidance and information she provided to my girlfriend and me were incredibly helpful. We’re so grateful for her support during this transition. We highly recommend her services.
